title: Communication Fault Diagnostic Guide
content: For intermittent controller communication faults, capture the diagnostic state before clearing codes. Inspect battery supply, ignition supply, grounds, connector condition, harness integrity and network termination. Check whether the fault changes with key cycles or temperature.

title: Vehicle Speed Signal Guide
content: For implausible vehicle speed, compare the displayed speed with diagnostic vehicle-speed parameters. Inspect the speed sensor circuit, transmission-related wiring, controller inputs and network messages. Reproduce the condition when possible before replacing components.

title: Intermittent Electrical Fault Guide
content: Intermittent electrical issues should be investigated using evidence captured during the event. Consider voltage drop, grounds, connector retention, harness movement, moisture intrusion, temperature and vibration.

title: Quality Problem Solving Guide
content: A strong root-cause investigation separates facts from hypotheses. Use containment first, then verify the failure mechanism with controlled testing. Corrective actions should address both occurrence and detection controls.

title: PFMEA Review Guide
content: PFMEA reviews should consider failure mode, effect, cause, prevention controls and detection controls. Historical warranty and field data should be used as inputs when available.

title: AI Governance Guide
content: AI-generated recommendations used in engineering or quality workflows require human review. Sensitive information should only be processed in approved enterprise environments with appropriate access controls.
